title: Eurostat's air emissions accounts by NACE Rev. 2 activity, with households' direct emissions
provider: Eurostat, the statistical office of the European Union (dissemination API 1.0): dataset env_ac_ainah_r2
licence: Eurostat's copyright notice: reuse of Eurostat data is authorised, commercial or not, provided the source is acknowledged (Commission Decision 2011/833/EU; the data are offered under the terms of CC BY 4.0; checked 2026-11-13).
citation: Eurostat, Air emissions accounts by NACE Rev. 2 activity, dataset env_ac_ainah_r2, https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/databrowser/view/env_ac_ainah_r2/
format: JSON-stat, tonnes: airpol (GHG in CO2 equivalent and its gases, acidifying gases in SO2 equivalent, particulates and others), nace_r2 (the activities of NACE Rev. 2 at A64, whose codes write both ends of a range, C10-C12 where the input–output tables write C10-12; and households: HH_HEAT, HH_TRA, HH_OTH), geo, time. The accounts follow the residence principle, as the input–output tables do.
coverage: The European Union's members, the EU27 as a whole and EFTA countries, 1995 to the latest year reported.

eu27-2022.description: The European Union's accounts for 2022: greenhouse gases and their gases, acidifying gases, PM2.5
